purpose: S072 electrically neutral fermion influence, current spectrum and consistent second-order phase response

sources.reading_scope: Appendix A and A.1, read in full in the preceding phase-action work: the electric field couples to the common charged boson and leaves SU(n)_1 matter. Used to identify which oscillator must be removed from the fermionic input. The present multipoint functions, spectral bounds and response formula are derived separately. Nonlinear angular/coset completion is not imported.

Sections I, II.6 and III read in full. Comparator for source-dependent scattering influence actions, their normalization and the additional hypotheses of the channel-diagonal reservoir specialization. That specialization is not substituted for the correlated strip state; the retained derivation uses explicit fermion Wick contractions and bosonic projection.

inherited_evidence.role: Prepared strip covariance, compact-state caveats and the phase action already containing the common electric current. The old free-junction calculation remains a valid reference; the present subtraction is required when retaining the electric phase separately.

novelty: Wick determinants, Abelian bosonization and contour influence expansions are established methods. The explicit projected kernels and source-response comparison are ordinary derivations; no exhaustive novelty acceptance.
limitations: The neutral sector still includes the angular SU(2) current algebra
Normal-ordered reference charge vertices must not be identified with unitary gauged vertices without coupling normalization
A finite-band contour functional is not a proof of continuum stress renormalization
Per-channel small coupling does not by itself bound the collective interacting phase evolution
No completed physical switching stress, geometry control, preparation or sufficient stability result
